name: Southwest Plus Business

benefits.name: Anniversary points
benefits.notes: 3,000 Rapid Rewards points each cardmember anniversary.

benefits.name: Companion Pass boost
benefits.notes: 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points each calendar year.

benefits.name: 10% flight discount
benefits.notes: 10% promo code each cardmember anniversary (excludes Basic fares).

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: $10 credit loaded into your Instacart+ account each month; requires an active Instacart+ membership (3 months complimentary, then paid) and an order paid with the card. Unused credit expires at month end.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter while enrolled in DashPass via the card (12 months complimentary, then paid). Offer runs through 12/31/2027 (activate DashPass by then).

benefits.name: Free first checked bag
benefits.notes: First standard checked bag free for the primary cardmember and up to 8 passengers on the same reservation (Rapid Rewards number on the reservation; Southwest-operated flights).

benefits.name: Complimentary Standard seat
benefits.notes: Select a Standard seat within 48 hours before departure, when available, for the cardmember and up to 8 passengers on the reservation.

benefits.name: 25% back on inflight
benefits.notes: 25% statement credit on Southwest inflight drink and Wi-Fi purchases made with the card.

benefits.name: DashPass membership
benefits.notes: 12 months of complimentary DashPass when first activated with the card by 12/31/2027, then auto-renews at the paid rate until cancelled. Activation window 2/1/2025-12/31/2027.
